review.conclusion_reason: YES is supported by the current refuge regulation and FWS management record, connected to EO 7229 through EO 8517's express identification and rename. The project rules do not require the current agency record itself to repeat the order number. No whole-order ending appears in the checked sources; formal status is upheld only as the bounded statement 'never_expressly_ended_found.' The original naming command ended on August 16, 1940. Exact survival of every original parcel and the administration language remain unresolved.
review.stop_code_verdict: confirmed: the evidence slice supplies no current source naming EO 7229 as present reservation authority. NOT_FOUND is supported within this bounded record, not as a claim that the proposed FWS sources were exhaustively searched.

verdicts.reason: Held GPO OCR contains the quoted reservation, including other wildlife, and identifies EO 7229 dated November 19, 1935.
Second held government printing contains the reservation words and [No. 7229]; its signing-year OCR discrepancy does not affect those words.
The held printing expressly says: 'This refuge shall be known as the Delta Migratory Waterfowl Refuge.'
The complete cited APP transcription adds land to the refuge established by EO 7229 and contains no revocation of that order. Its transcription-only limitation is correctly stated.
Held 2 FR 141 text expressly reserves additional land as an addition to the refuge established by EO 7229; the order contains no revocation of EO 7229.
Held EO 8517 section 2 says the additional lands are 'included in and reserved as a part of the refuge.' This confirms continuation in 1940, not independently at the cutoff.
Held EO 8517 section 1 names EO 7229 and expressly changes the refuge's name to Delta National Wildlife Refuge; its signature date is August 16, 1940.
The cited Cornell page contains the quoted Delta heading at subsection (m). Its amendment history ends with 91 FR 56326, September 1, 2026, exactly as claimed.

The cited FWS page contains the exact habitat phrase and a '2026-2027 Hunting Information' heading with a public-use brochure link. The historical fetch event itself is not independently auditable, but the page content is confirmed.

stop_code_verdict: confirmed: the evidence slice supplies no current source naming EO 7229 as present reservation authority. NOT_FOUND is supported within this bounded record, not as a claim that the proposed FWS sources were exhaustively searched.
